CustomField.formula: IF(ISPICKVAL( AuditType__c , "Pre-Audit"), ( StartofRenewalPeriod__c -( WeeksBeforeRenewaltoRunPreAudit__c *7 )), IF( ISPICKVAL( AuditType__c , "Post-Audit"), ( LicenseTypeExpireDate__c +( WeeksAfterRenewaltoRunPostAudit__c *7 ) ), NULL))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This is the date on which the system will automatically run the Pre or Post Audit.
CustomField.label: Run Audit Date
